requirement: A Mostrador sale can show a one-time code that the customer confirms
expected: After Registrar venta (Tienda física) the store sees Mostrar código al cliente; the QR and link open /compra-en-tienda/<code>; Sí, compré en <Tienda> creates a verified transaction for the store
preconditions: Deal-trust migrations applied; prototype with deal-trust-seed.sql
steps: Mostrador: add BOSS-DS1, Registrar venta, Mostrar código al cliente; open the link as comprador@laria.test and confirm

requirement: A code works once, for 24 hours, and closes when the sale is undone or replaced
expected: A second confirmation, an expired code, a cancelled code, a replaced code and a code of an undone sale are all refused; only the SHA-256 is stored

requirement: Customers can't inflate a store's record
expected: Own store refused; one counter purchase per store per customer a day; five a day in all

requirement: Only the store's owner makes, reads and cancels its codes
expected: Another account gets an error for create, status and cancel; anon can't read store_counter_sales

requirement: A confirmed counter sale can't be undone from the Mostrador
expected: Undoing a movement of a claimed sale is refused; a return is recorded as a return and the transaction stays

requirement: A counter purchase appears wherever a review can
expected: Compras y ventas (both sides, En tienda), the transaction page, Reseñas pendientes, the store's reputation, Admin > Reseñas and the reported-review queue

requirement: The Mostrador sees the confirmation
expected: The open QR sheet shows the customer's first name and initial within a few seconds and offers to close
preconditions: Deal-trust migrations applied; prototype with deal-trust-seed.sql
steps: Keep the sheet open while the customer confirms

requirement: Counter purchases get their review reminder
expected: One reminder per person two days before the window ends; the existing listing reminder job skips them without failing

requirement: The QR encodes the claim link
expected: An independent decoder reads the URL back for versions 1 to 10 and every mask; damaged symbols fail

requirement: Admin can spot repeated confirmations
expected: Admin > Confianza > Compras en tienda lists confirmed counter purchases with confirmations by the same customer at the same store in 30 days
preconditions: Deal-trust migrations applied; prototype with deal-trust-seed.sql

requirement: Admin moderates review photos
expected: Admin > Confianza > Fotos de reseñas approves or hides with a reason, audited
